scripts.build:extensions: yarn run recrate:build && lerna run build --stream --sort --skip-nx-cache
scripts.build:rocrate-tools: yarn workspace rocrate-core build && yarn workspace rocrate-mcp-server build
scripts.test:rocrate-tools: yarn workspace rocrate-core test && yarn workspace rocrate-mcp-server test
scripts.build:browser: yarn run build:extensions && yarn workspace browser-app run bundle
scripts.build:electron: yarn run build:extensions && yarn workspace electron-app run bundle
scripts.rebuild:electron: yarn run clean && yarn && yarn run build:electron
scripts.rebuild:browser: yarn run clean && yarn && yarn run build:browser
scripts.recrate:publish: yarn workspace @arpproject/recrate build && (cd dev-packages/recrate && npm publish)
